evidence.why: Initializer writes, ordered animation branches and inert callbacks.

facts.rationale: Corrects the omission of reset-before-stop ordering while retaining the supported single-state and inert-phase behavior.
facts.value: The table exposes one item state, state 0. Its animation callback first re-enters state 0 when it_80272C6C returns zero; re-entry reinstalls the accessory callback, clears masterhandlaser.x0, and reloads x8 from attribute x4. It then tests x0: an observed set flag causes removal of the stored root JObj's reference constraints and a true return; otherwise it returns false. A pending termination request can therefore be erased by re-entry. Physics is empty and collision always returns false.

facts.rationale: Qualifies the existing lifetime explanation with the directly demonstrated reset branch.
facts.value: Runs the laser item's animation-reset and deferred lifetime check. A zero result from it_80272C6C first re-enters state 0, clearing any pending termination request. The callback then tests masterhandlaser.x0; if still set, it removes the stored root JObj's reference constraints and returns true, otherwise false. It does not guarantee completion on the next update after an owner request.

evidence.why: Setter, entry writes and ordered consumer.
Owner signals and relinquishes four handles.

facts.rationale: Adds the omitted flag reset and identifies the attribute-derived counter without treating reset and termination as independent branches.
facts.value: Each invocation first calls it_80272C6C. If it returns zero, state 0 is re-entered, the accessory callback is reinstalled, x0 is cleared, and the contact-effect counter x8 is reloaded from attribute x4. Only afterward is x0 tested. A set flag at that point removes the stored root JObj's reference constraints and returns true; a clear flag returns false. Thus re-entry can erase an owner-issued stop request. Master Hand's ending transition signals all four retained articles and clears its handles independently of this later item-side observation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing explanation's assertion that reset and termination branches are independent.
facts.value: Unconditionally enters item state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, installs it_802F05A8 as the accessory callback, clears masterhandlaser.x0, and reloads the contact-effect counter x8 from attribute x4. The animation callback invokes this initializer when it_80272C6C returns zero, before testing x0. Consequently this reset can erase a pending termination request; constraint removal and a true animation result occur only when x0 is subsequently observed set.

evidence.why: Accessory ordering, full-length setup, query, ratio and contact/no-contact branches.

facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported first-intersection ordering with the actual returned-contact contract and preserves exceptional arithmetic and timer branches.
facts.value: Updates a laser beam's displayed length against stage geometry before accessory-side hitbox maintenance. It begins with dynamic bone 2 translated by -attrs->x0, queries the XY segment from the selected owner joint to that endpoint, and on contact adjusts the bone using the intersection returned by mpCheckMultiple. The translation calculation combines the original 3D beam length with an XY distance ratio and has no explicit zero-denominator guard. On contact updates only, it decrements x8, emits effect 0x405 when the result is negative, and reloads x8 from attrs->x4. Without contact it retains full length and does not advance the counter.

evidence.why: Complete state, construction, signaling and accessory paths.

facts.rationale: Separates requesting shutdown from actual constraint removal and records the reset-before-observation exception.
facts.value: The unit has one registered item state, state 0. Entry installs accessory processing, clears termination flag x0 and loads contact-effect counter x8 from attribute x4. The root model is attached to the selected owner joint during construction. The shutdown helper merely sets x0 for a non-null article. Animation processing first re-enters state 0 when its query returns zero, which can clear that request, and only then checks x0. An observed set flag removes the root's JObj-reference constraints and returns true; otherwise animation returns false. Physics is empty and collision returns false. Accessory processing maintains beam geometry and enabled hitbox endpoints, with contact-only counter progression.
